core_findings.result: The scalar tower identifies the actual coefficientwise maps and representations. Applying the local map A-to-O preserves the literal Free matrix identity and every ideal-power continuity condition. OST19/OST24 supply finite free ordinary modules and the exact coefficientwise tensor map for arbitrary local maps, including noninjective/nonflat maps and nonreduced A. OCT3/6/7/10/15 give the exact classical integral lattice, positive stability, ordinary lattice and actual inverse control at each original level and depth; O remains precisely a CNL domain.

For every nonzero classical F, the finite representative coordinates span exactly all global untwisted coordinates, by the all-submodule version of OCT3. Every positive normalized summand has integral matrix xi(n) chi(a)^(-1) xi(a); every away translate has integral matrix tau_O(u) on its separate index. Thus the eigenvalue acts on a finite nonzero O-module in Omega. The adjugate determinant argument gives a monic annihilator without requiring that this module be free, that O be a DVR, or that the away sum preserve the classical space. It covers all nonzero classical eigenvectors, not only the ordinary subspace, and keeps finite-list multiplicities.

Smaller away subgroup and deeper local depth enlarge the literal classical ordinary spaces because the ambient distinguished operator is unchanged. Directedness and max(e1,e2) put any two good lifts into one space where the original control is injective. This proves uniqueness before defining sp. The inverse integral control applied to the actual base-change vector is a good lift at every admissible level/depth. The same sp is defined on every ambient A-valued function, with zero for functions having no lift; the empty index-set case is treated without an extra nonemptiness hypothesis.

Additivity and A-semilinearity follow from good-lift uniqueness and the exact coefficient map gamma=beta alpha. The ordinary spaces form a directed system under actual inclusions, so the optional mixed-level extension is valid and makes no new choices.

The literal base-change image of any A-basis is an O-basis, and its inverse-control image is an integral ordinary basis. Spanning follows from the exact Omega-span of this lattice. Independence follows by applying control and using finite evaluation minors for O-linearly independent functions, with beta injective and O a domain. This is valid for arbitrary basis index types because each relation has finite support; it does not incorrectly infer injectivity of A-to-O.

The normalized positive operators preserve the integral ordinary lattice, and the original control intertwines them with the original coefficient-valued U-operator. Coefficientwise application commutes with its finite coset sums on the N-fixed ordinary input, with the source representative independence retained. The result is a good lift of the exact U_A(a)f; uniqueness gives the stated equality for the one fixed map.

The original hypothesis concerns only the entire away-fixed ambient space. Each away translate preserves twisted global equivariance and commutes with all local actions; the fixed-space hypothesis therefore yields the required classical-space inclusion. Integral matrix entries and commutation with the distinguished operator give ordinary lattice preservation by OCT19. The exact control and coefficientwise identities then make the away image a good lift of the ambient A-function A_f f. No A-ordinarity assumption on this argument is needed or introduced, because SMP5 defined sp on all ambient functions.

Compared directly with every conjunct of FreeMap.lean absSpec: all K and all e>=c, positive preservation and eigenvalue integrality on all nonzero classical eigenvectors, every finite indexed away sum without preservation assumption for integrality, one map with restricted additivity/semilinearity, all-level span, arbitrary original bases, every positive operator, and exact cross-level away-sum compatibility. Named tau-prime and phi-prime are identified by their supplied equalities; all original hypotheses are retained.
